title: एकपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Yudhishthira tells Arjuna how, after he left for the Samshaptakas, Drona pressed the army and Abhimanyu broke into the wheel array, where he was killed after Jayadratha blocked the rest. Arjuna, overcome, falls silent in grief.
summary.kn: ಅರ್ಜುನ ಸಂಶಪ್ತಕರತ್ತ ಹೋದ ಬಳಿಕ ದ್ರೋಣ ಸೈನ್ಯವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಿದ್ದನ್ನೂ, ಅಭಿಮನ್ಯು ಚಕ್ರವ್ಯೂಹ ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸಿದ್ದನ್ನೂ, ಜಯದ್ರಥ ಉಳಿದವರನ್ನು ತಡೆದಾಗ ಅವನು ಕೊಲ್ಲಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿದ್ದನ್ನೂ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅರ್ಜುನ ದುಃಖದಿಂದ ಮೌನವಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर बताते हैं कि अर्जुन के संशप्तकों की ओर जाने पर द्रोण ने सेना को दबाया, अभिमन्यु चक्रव्यूह में घुसा, और जयद्रथ के बाकी को रोकने पर वह मारा गया। अर्जुन शोक से मौन हो जाते हैं।
summary.te: అర్జునుడు సంశప్తకుల వైపు వెళ్లాక ద్రోణుడు సేనను ఒత్తిడి చేయడం, అభిమన్యుడు చక్రవ్యూహంలోకి దూకడం, జయద్రథుడు మిగతావారిని ఆపగా అతడు చంపబడటం యుధిష్ఠిరుడు చెబుతాడు. అర్జునుడు దుఃఖంతో మౌనమవుతాడు.
summary.ta: அர்ஜுனன் சம்சப்தகரிடம் சென்றபின் த்ரோணர் படையை நெருக்கியதையும், அபிமன்யு சக்கர வியூகத்தில் நுழைந்ததையும், ஜயத்ரதன் மற்றவரைத் தடுக்க அவன் கொல்லப்பட்டதையும் யுதிஷ்டிரர் கூறுகிறார். அர்ஜுனன் துயரத்தால் மௌனமாகிறான்.
summary.ml: താൻ സംശപ്തകരുടെ അടുത്തേക്ക് പോയശേഷം ദ്രോണർ സേനയെ അമർത്തിയതും, ജയദ്രഥൻ മറ്റുള്ളവരെ തടഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ അഭിമന്യു ചക്രവ്യൂഹത്തിൽ കടന്ന് വധിക്കപ്പെട്ടതും യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ അർജുനനോട് പറയുന്നു. ദുഃഖം അടക്കാനാകാതെ അർജുനൻ മൗനിയാകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.51; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
त्वयि याते महाबाहो संशप्तकबलं प्रति ।
प्रयत्नमकरोत्तीव्रमाचार्यो ग्रहणे मम ॥

meaning.en: When you, mighty-armed one, had gone against the Samshaptaka force, the teacher Drona made a fierce effort to capture me.

verses.text:
व्यूढानीकं वयं द्रोणं वरयामः स्म सर्वशः ।
प्रतिव्यूह्य रथानीकं यतमानं तथा रणे ॥

meaning.en: We faced Drona on every side as he drew up his ranks, and we countered by arranging our own chariot force to resist him in battle.

verses.text:
स वार्यमाणो रथिभी रक्षितेन मया तथा ।
अस्मानपि जघानाशु पीडयन्निशितैः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: Though held back by the chariot-warriors and by me, whom they were guarding, he struck us down swiftly, tormenting us with sharp arrows.

verses.text:
ते पीड्यमाना द्रोणेन द्रोणानीकं न शक्नुमः ।
प्रतिवीक्षितुमप्याजौ भेत्तुं तत्कुत एव तु ॥

meaning.en: Pressed so by Drona, we could not even look at Drona's army in the battle, let alone break it.

verses.text:
वयं त्वप्रतिमं वीर्ये सर्वे सौभद्रमात्मजम् ।
उक्तवन्तः स्म ते तात भिन्ध्यनीकमिति प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: Then we all told your son, Subhadra's son, who is unmatched in strength: "Child, break their formation."

verses.text:
स तथा चोदितोऽस्माभिः सदश्व इव वीर्यवान् ।
असह्यमपि तं भारं वोढुमेवोपचक्रमे ॥

meaning.en: Urged by us, that valiant boy, like a good horse, set out to bear a burden that no one else could bear.

verses.text:
स तवास्त्रोपदेशेन वीर्येण च समन्वितः ।
प्राविशत्तद्बलं बालः सुपर्ण इव सागरम् ॥

meaning.en: Equipped with your teaching of weapons and with his own strength, that boy entered their force like Garuda plunging into the sea.

verses.text:
तेऽनुयाता वयं वीरं सात्वतीपुत्रमाहवे ।
प्रवेष्टुकामास्तेनैव येन स प्राविशच्चमूम् ॥

meaning.en: We followed that hero, Satvati's grandson, wishing to enter by the same way he had entered the host.

verses.text:
ततः सैन्धवको राजा क्षुद्रस्तात जयद्रथः ।
वरदानेन रुद्रस्य सर्वान्नः समवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Then the petty Sindhu king, Jayadratha, my dear, held all of us back by a boon from Rudra.

verses.text:
ततो द्रोणः कृपः कर्णो द्रौणिश्च स बृहद्बलः ।
कृतवर्मा च सौभद्रं षड्रथाः पर्यवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: Then six chariot-warriors, Drona, Kripa, Karna, Drona's son, Brihadbala and Kritavarman, surrounded Subhadra's son.

verses.text:
परिवार्य तु तैः सर्वैर्युधि बालो महारथैः ।
यतमानः परं शक्त्या बहुभिर्विरथीकृतः ॥

meaning.en: Surrounded by all those great chariot-warriors, the boy, striving with all his strength, was left chariotless by the many.

verses.text:
ततो दौःशासनिः क्षिप्रं तथा तैर्विरथीकृतम् ।
संशयं परमं प्राप्य दिष्टान्तेनाभ्ययोजयत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Duhshasana's son, finding him chariotless and in extreme danger, quickly brought him to his end.

verses.text:
स तु हत्वा सहस्राणि द्विपाश्वरथसादिनाम् ।
राजपुत्रशतं चाग्र्यं वीरांश्चालक्षितान्बहून् ॥

meaning.en: Before that, he had killed thousands of elephant, horse, chariot and cavalry soldiers, a hundred of the best princes, and many unnoticed heroes.

verses.text:
बृहद्बलं च राजानं स्वर्गेणाजौ प्रयोज्य ह ।
ततः परमधर्मात्मा दिष्टान्तमुपजग्मिवान् ॥

meaning.en: Sending King Brihadbala to heaven in the battle, that supremely righteous one then reached his end.

verses.text:
एतावदेव निर्वृत्तमस्माकं शोकवर्धनम् ।
स चैवं पुरुषव्याघ्रः स्वर्गलोकमवाप्तवान् ॥

meaning.en: This is all that has happened, increasing our grief. Thus that tiger among men has reached the world of heaven.

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
ततोऽर्जुनो वचः श्रुत्वा धर्मराजेन भाषितम् ।
हा पुत्र इति निःश्वस्य व्यथितो न्यपतद्भुवि ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the words of King Yudhishthira, Arjuna sighed, "Alas, my son!", and fell to the ground in pain.

verses.text:
विषण्णवदनाः सर्वे परिगृह्य धनंजयम् ।
नेत्रैरनिमिषैर्दीनाः प्रत्यवेक्षन्परस्परम् ॥

meaning.en: All with sad faces took hold of Dhananjaya and looked at one another with unblinking, miserable eyes.

verses.text:
प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञां वासविः क्रोधमूर्छितः ।
कम्पमानो ज्वरेणेव निःश्वसंश्च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥

meaning.en: Regaining consciousness, Indra's son, faint with rage, trembling as with fever and sighing again and again, ground his hands together.

verses.text:
पाणिं पाणौ विनिष्पिष्य श्वसमानोऽश्रुनेत्रवान् ।
उन्मत्त इव विप्रेक्षन्निदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: With tears in his eyes and breathing hard, he looked around like a madman and spoke these words.

verses.text:
सत्यं वः प्रतिजानामि श्वोऽस्मि हन्ता जयद्रथम् ।
न चेद्वधभयाद्भीतो धार्तराष्ट्रान्प्रहास्यति ॥

meaning.en: "I make you a true promise: tomorrow I shall kill Jayadratha. Unless, afraid of being killed, he abandons the sons of Dhritarashtra."

verses.text:
न चास्माञ्शरणं गच्छेत्कृष्णं वा पुरुषोत्तमम् ।
भवन्तं वा महाराज श्वोऽस्मि हन्ता जयद्रथम् ॥

meaning.en: "Unless he seeks refuge with us, or with Krishna, the best of men, or with you, great king, tomorrow I shall kill Jayadratha."

verses.text:
धार्तराष्ट्रप्रियकरं मयि विस्मृतसौहृदम् ।
पापं बालवधे हेतुं श्वोऽस्मि हन्ता जयद्रथम् ॥

meaning.en: "That sinner, who does the Dhritarashtras' pleasure, forgot his friendship with me and was the cause of the boy's death. Tomorrow I shall kill Jayadratha."

verses.text:
रक्षमाणाश्च तं संख्ये ये मां योत्स्यन्ति केचन ।
अपि द्रोणकृपौ वीरौ छादयिष्यामि ताञ्शरैः ॥

meaning.en: "Whoever fights me in battle to protect him, even the heroes Drona and Kripa, I shall cover them with arrows."

verses.text:
यद्येतदेवं संग्रामे न कुर्यां पुरुषर्षभाः ।
मा स्म पुण्यकृतां लोकान्प्राप्नुयां शूरसंमतान् ॥

meaning.en: "Bulls among men, if I do not do this in battle, may I not reach the worlds of the righteous that brave men honour."

verses.text:
ये लोका मातृहन्तॄणां ये चापि पितृघातिनाम् ।
गुरुदारगामिनां ये च पिशुनानां च ये तथा ॥

meaning.en: "May I reach the worlds of those who kill their mothers, who kill their fathers, who sleep with their teachers' wives, who are slanderers,"

verses.text:
साधूनसूयतां ये च ये चापि परिवादिनाम् ।
ये च निक्षेपहर्तॄणां ये च विश्वासघातिनाम् ॥

meaning.en: "who hate the good, who revile others, who steal what is entrusted, who betray trust,"

verses.text:
भुक्तपूर्वां स्त्रियं ये च निन्दतामघशंसिनाम् ।
ब्रह्मघ्नानां च ये लोका ये च गोघातिनामपि ॥

meaning.en: "who disparage a woman they once enjoyed, who proclaim others' sins, who kill brahmins, and who kill cows."

verses.text:
पायसं वा यवान्नं वा शाकं कृसरमेव वा ।
संयावापूपमांसानि ये च लोका वृथाश्नताम् ।
तानह्नैवाधिगच्छेयं न चेद्धन्यां जयद्रथम् ॥

meaning.en: "I shall reach in a single day the worlds of those who needlessly eat rice pudding, barley food, greens, kichri, sweet cakes or meat, if I do not kill Jayadratha."

verses.text:
वेदाध्यायिनमत्यर्थं संशितं वा द्विजोत्तमम् ।
अवमन्यमानो यान्याति वृद्धान्साधूंस्तथा गुरून् ॥

meaning.en: "He who scorns a brahmin that studies the Vedas intensely or one of firm vows, or insults elders, the good and teachers, has a certain fate."

verses.text:
स्पृशतां ब्राह्मणं गां च पादेनाग्निं च यां लभेत् ।
याप्सु श्लेष्म पुरीषं वा मूत्रं वा मुञ्चतां गतिः ।
तां गच्छेयं गतिं घोरां न चेद्धन्यां जयद्रथम् ॥

meaning.en: "The fate of those who touch a brahmin, a cow or fire with the foot, or who pass phlegm, excrement or urine in water, may I reach that dreadful fate if I do not kill Jayadratha."

verses.text:
नग्नस्य स्नायमानस्य या च वन्ध्यातिथेर्गतिः ।
उत्कोचिनां मृषोक्तीनां वञ्चकानां च या गतिः ।
आत्मापहारिणां या च या च मिथ्याभिशंसिनाम् ॥

meaning.en: "The fate of one who bathes naked, of one who turns away a guest, of bribe-takers, liars and cheats, of those who deceive themselves, and of false accusers."

verses.text:
भृत्यैः संदृश्यमानानां पुत्रदाराश्रितैस्तथा ।
असंविभज्य क्षुद्राणां या गतिर्मृष्टमश्नताम् ।
तां गच्छेयं गतिं घोरां न चेद्धन्यां जयद्रथम् ॥

meaning.en: "The fate of petty men who eat sweets alone while their servants, sons, wives and dependants look on without sharing, may I reach that dreadful fate if I do not kill Jayadratha."

verses.text:
संश्रितं वापि यस्त्यक्त्वा साधुं तद्वचने रतम् ।
न बिभर्ति नृशंसात्मा निन्दते चोपकारिणम् ॥

meaning.en: "He who abandons a good man who depends on him and is devoted to his words, and who, cruel-hearted, does not support him and slights his benefactor."

verses.text:
अर्हते प्रातिवेश्याय श्राद्धं यो न ददाति च ।
अनर्हते च यो दद्याद्वृषलीपत्युरेव च ॥

meaning.en: "He who does not give a funeral-offering to a worthy neighbour, or who gives it to an unworthy one, and the husband of a low-caste woman."

verses.text:
मद्यपो भिन्नमर्यादः कृतघ्नो भ्रातृनिन्दकः ।
तेषां गतिमियां क्षिप्रं न चेद्धन्यां जयद्रथम् ॥

meaning.en: "A drunkard, a breaker of bounds, an ungrateful man, a slanderer of brothers: may I quickly reach their fate if I do not kill Jayadratha."

verses.text:
धर्मादपेता ये चान्ये मया नात्रानुकीर्तिताः ।
ये चानुकीर्तिताः क्षिप्रं तेषां गतिमवाप्नुयाम् ।
यदि व्युष्टामिमां रात्रिं श्वो न हन्यां जयद्रथम् ॥

meaning.en: "And for others fallen from dharma whom I have not named here, and for those I have named, may I quickly reach their fate, if I do not kill Jayadratha tomorrow when this night has passed."

verses.text:
इमां चाप्यपरां भूयः प्रतिज्ञां मे निबोधत ।
यद्यस्मिन्नहते पापे सूर्योऽस्तमुपयास्यति ।
इहैव संप्रवेष्टाहं ज्वलितं जातवेदसम् ॥

meaning.en: "Hear this further vow of mine. If the sun sets before that sinner is killed, I shall enter blazing fire right here."

verses.text:
असुरसुरमनुष्याः पक्षिणो वोरगा वा
पितृरजनिचरा वा ब्रह्मदेवर्षयो वा ।
चरमचरमपीदं यत्परं चापि तस्मा-
त्तदपि मम रिपुं तं रक्षितुं नैव शक्ताः ॥

meaning.en: "Asuras, gods, men, birds or serpents, ancestors, night-walkers, brahmins, gods or divine sages, this whole moving and unmoving world and what is beyond it, none of them can protect that enemy of mine."

verses.text:
यदि विशति रसातलं तदग्र्यं
वियदपि देवपुरं दितेः पुरं वा ।
तदपि शरशतैरहं प्रभाते
भृशमभिपत्य रिपोः शिरोऽभिहर्ता ॥

meaning.en: "If he enters Rasatala, the best of the nether worlds, or the sky, or the city of the gods, or the city of Diti, still at dawn I shall fall upon him with hundreds of arrows and cut off his enemy's head."

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा विचिक्षेप गाण्डीवं सव्यदक्षिणम् ।
तस्य शब्दमतिक्रम्य धनुःशब्दोऽस्पृशद्दिवम् ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, he twanged the Gandiva with both hands, and the sound of his bow rose above all other noise and touched the sky.

verses.text:
अर्जुनेन प्रतिज्ञाते पाञ्चजन्यं जनार्दनः ।
प्रदध्मौ तत्र संक्रुद्धो देवदत्तं धनंजयः ॥

meaning.en: When Arjuna had made this vow, Janardana sounded the Panchajanya, and in his rage Dhananjaya sounded the Devadatta.

verses.text:
स पाञ्चजन्योऽच्युतवक्त्रवायुना
भृशं सुपूर्णोदरनिःसृतध्वनिः ।
जगत्सपातालवियद्दिगीश्वरं
प्रकम्पयामास युगात्यये यथा ॥

meaning.en: The Panchajanya, filled by the breath from Achyuta's mouth, sent out a sound from its deep belly that shook the world with its nether regions, sky, directions and their lords, as at the end of an age.

verses.text:
ततो वादित्रघोषाश्च प्रादुरासन्समन्ततः ।
सिंहनादाश्च पाण्डूनां प्रतिज्ञाते महात्मना ॥

meaning.en: Then the sounds of instruments rose on every side, and the Pandavas roared like lions when the great-souled one had made his vow.
